# Flex Consumption workload profile with integrated vnet

This deploys a Container Apps Managed Environment using the Flex Consumption workload profile, using vnet integration and an external load balancer.

To modify this to use an internal load balancer, set the following parameter: `internal_load_balancer_enabled = true`.

This will create an additional resource group for platform managed resources that is prefixed with "ME-". To choose a different name, set the parameter: `infrastructure_resource_group_name`.

```hcl
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.12, < 2.0"

  required_providers {
    azapi = {
      source  = "Azure/azapi"
      version = "~> 2.12"
    }
  }
}

# This ensures we have unique CAF compliant names for our resources.
module "naming" {
  source  = "Azure/avm-utl-naming/azure"
  version = "0.2.0"
}

# This is required for resource modules
resource "azapi_resource" "resource_group" {
  location = "centralindia"
  name     = module.naming.resource_group.name_unique
  type     = "Microsoft.Resources/resourceGroups@2024-03-01"
}

resource "azapi_resource" "log_analytics_workspace" {
  location  = azapi_resource.resource_group.location
  name      = module.naming.log_analytics_workspace.name_unique
  parent_id = azapi_resource.resource_group.id
  type      = "Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces@2023-09-01"
  body = {
    properties = {
      retentionInDays = 30
      sku = {
        name = "PerGB2018"
      }
    }
  }
}

# Create the vnet to use with vnet integration
resource "azapi_resource" "virtual_network" {
  location  = azapi_resource.resource_group.location
  name      = module.naming.virtual_network.name_unique
  parent_id = azapi_resource.resource_group.id
  type      = "Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks@2024-05-01"
  body = {
    properties = {
      addressSpace = {
        addressPrefixes = ["192.168.0.0/23"]
      }
      subnets = [
        {
          name = module.naming.subnet.name_unique
          properties = {
            addressPrefix = "192.168.0.0/23"
            delegations = [
              {
                name = "Microsoft.App.environments"
                properties = {
                  serviceName = "Microsoft.App/environments"
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}

module "managedenvironment" {
  source = "../../"

  location                = azapi_resource.resource_group.location
  name                    = module.naming.container_app_environment.name_unique
  resource_group_name     = azapi_resource.resource_group.name
  enable_telemetry        = var.enable_telemetry
  log_analytics_workspace = { resource_id = azapi_resource.log_analytics_workspace.id }
  vnet_configuration = {
    infrastructure_subnet_id = "${azapi_resource.virtual_network.id}/subnets/${module.naming.subnet.name_unique}"
    internal                 = false
  }
  workload_profiles = [
    {
      name                  = "Flex"
      workload_profile_type = "Flex"
    }
  ]
  zone_redundant = true
}
```
